steps.content: —!! Mmph!
In the dark alley, a man's body goes rigid before breaking into uncontrollable convulsions.

steps.speaker: Number Two
steps.content: Hey, Boss! You alright?!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Pant... Pant... That's it... That's the spot! Heh... Hehehahaha! I can feel it... It's right there! My nose never lies!

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Those people... they've got what we missed last time! I can smell it on them!

steps.speaker: Number Four
steps.content: You sure, Boss? They just look like three regular ladies... Doesn't exactly scream "loaded."

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Don't you doubt the nose of the Marauder! That painting they're carrying... Its scent... It's cleaner, purer than anything I've ever caught before! That's the one!

steps.speaker: Number Four
steps.content: So... same plan as always?

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: We wait till they get close to the alley, then we move—Mmph...

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Keep it quiet, folks... If this goes sideways, that one in gray... will come for us!

Originally, they were all short-term inmates at the Eastside Public Security Bureau's detention center. They had each been locked up for theft of varying degrees, and with such common ground, they quickly became sworn brothers.
On the eve of their release, one of them suddenly awakened as a Sinner.

steps.speaker: Number Two
steps.content: Hey, come quick! Look at Boss! He's... chewing on something...
Everyone rushed over and discovered their boss, his eyes wild, gnawing frantically at a Public Security Bureau propaganda poster as if possessed.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Not enough! I need more! This isn't cutting it! Quick... find me paintings... I'll make you all rich!
Number Two rushed over and grabbed Boss's shoulders, trying to steady him. Across the room, the rest of the underlings exchanged bewildered glances.

steps.speaker: Number Three
steps.content: What do we do? Get him a painting to chew on? Otherwise, before we're out, they'll transfer him straight to MBCC.

steps.speaker: Number Four
steps.content: Yeah, guess that's our only move for now.
After leaving the detention center, the group began plotting their next moves.
Boss's ability isn't particularly powerful, but for thieves, it's invaluable: he senses any famous painting within a one-kilometer radius.

This human radar—who also fights with the prowess of a Sinner—is why the gang thrives. They pull off heist after heist, make fortunes fencing stolen goods, and slip away right under the Public Security Bureau's nose.
Yet the drawback of his ability is equally clear. It creates in him a craving for famous paintings; the more valuable the piece, the harder it is to suppress the hunger.
Exactly as is happening now.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: —GRAAAHHH!!

He casts aside the promise to his underlings, the torment of his hunger now irresistible. In a sudden, feral lunge, he blocks the path of the three Kisugi sisters as they stroll through the evening streets of Eastside.

steps.speaker: Boss
steps.content: Give... me... the painting!
